title: Chọn visual world cho lần redesign Ai eo
question: Roll giao Tabletop Route; một hướng đánh bại cả hai axis. Giữ hướng nào, re-roll, hay lấy chuẩn ngành?

options.label: Tabletop Route
options.thesis: Progress you can see: your token riding a printed board of lesson tiles.
options.viewport: Shell as the board's frame: a route strip crosses the dashboard with the token sitting on today's lesson tile.
options.risk: Serious exam screens risk reading as play; marking and admin surfaces are where the costume would show.

raised.raise: From the guide map — colour owns whole regions: the shell rides one committed field, never accents on grey.
From the star atlas — hierarchy by size: bands and ranks read as a fixed magnitude ramp of dots.
From the exposure record — one tonal ramp: every neutral snaps to a locked scale, no ad-hoc greys.

options.label: Sticker Sheet
options.thesis: Every badge, streak and hard-won answer lands as a die-cut sticker placed on the sheet.
options.viewport: Dashboard as a sticker sheet: progress card peeled at one corner, Bơ's stickers collecting down one edge.
options.risk: Also the place every friendly edtech lands — familiarity is the trade.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: The attempt as a coupon wallet: four skills as legs, every state stamped.
options.viewport: Coupon-stacked dashboard: route header HAN → BAND 7.0, four skill coupons, stamped states, carbon band figures.
options.case: Beats the roll on both axes: coupons, stubs and stamps map straight onto sections, remaining work and the DRAFT→ARCHIVED lifecycle — and for a Vietnamese candidate the ticket is what the exam buys.
options.risk: Official-precise voice turns cold unless the warmth of the owner's pastel register rides along.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.thesis: Lessons, rivals and rewards as a ranked pastel roster around Bơ's cast.
options.viewport: Roster dashboard: pastel cells with rank ribbons, name plates, one-line notes, a bounce as focus lands.
options.case: Holds identification outright — it is the register the owner sent — but a finite ranked roster carries progress weakly beside a route and dresses the exam core in costume.
options.risk: Reads as the friendly category default the moment the roster stops doing product work.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.thesis: Results as plates: every band stamped, every credit hairlined.
options.viewport: Plate dashboard: crosshair-registered result plates, mono metadata rows, one periwinkle estimate seal.
options.case: Holds product clarity: stamps and hairline plates are built for labelled estimates and tabular results; loses identification against the playful register this owner loves.
options.risk: Quiet to the point of austere beside the pastel energy in the brief.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.thesis: Each area a swelling lobe of flat colour; the coastline does all the dividing.
options.viewport: One lobe dominates each screen, its coast leaving the frame on two sides.
options.case: Fuses poorly: candidates do not identify with a zoo visit, and lobe topology would redraw the app's navigation for decoration.
options.risk: Reads illustrated-first; the working screen disappears under the map.
options.kept: Kept: colour as committed fields that own whole regions.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Bands as magnitudes: rank carried by dot size on a charted sky.
options.viewport: A navy field of magnitude-scaled dots with constellation lines tying attempts together.
options.case: Fuses poorly: its night ground fights the light register the owner pinned, and a chart-first screen buries the tasks.
options.risk: Beautiful, but it inverts the airy ground the brief asked for.
options.kept: Kept: size on a fixed ramp carries rank — bands and leaderboard positions read by diameter.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: State as density: hatch for load, crossed hatch for conflict, on one backlit ramp.
options.viewport: Stacked translucent record sheets sliding aside, each squared internally to the ramp.
options.case: Fuses poorly: darkroom craft is far from a Vietnamese candidate's world, and sheet-over-sheet would fight the app's single-surface model.
options.risk: Obscure vocabulary — stop-deltas mean nothing to a learner.
options.kept: Kept: one locked tonal ramp; conflict as cross-hatch, never extra colour.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What every exam-prep platform ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects: top nav, stat tiles, list cards — at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
